title: DisposalEvent
description: Canonical disposal attempt event authored by the Raspberry Pi station runtime after a user finishes a sorting attempt.

stationId.description: Unique station identifier used across live status, events, and analytics aggregation.

timestamp.description: Time when the disposal attempt was finalized.

predictedItem.description: Final resolved item label produced by local or fallback classification.

correctDisposalMethod.description: Expected disposal method after applying the active local rules preset.

actualDisposalZone.description: Most recent tracked hand zone before the hand disappeared.

attemptResult.description: Outcome of comparing the correct disposal method against the detected disposal zone.

modelConfidence.description: Confidence score from the classification path that determined the final item label.

llmFallbackUsed.description: Whether the station used the fallback LLM path because local confidence was below the configured threshold.
